History and Devices views are now integrated directly into the terminal interface, alongside automatic removable drive discovery.

### Highlights

- **History Tab in TUI**: Inspect past downloads, filter by query, copy source URLs, open/reveal files in your system file manager, and manage history records directly from `nah`.
- **Devices Tab in TUI**: View all registered devices and API keys associated with your account, create new scoped keys, rotate existing keys, or revoke unused ones.
- **Removable Media & USB Discovery**: The folder picker now automatically detects connected USB drives and external volumes on Linux (`/run/media`, `/media`, `/mnt`), macOS (`/Volumes`), and Windows drive letters, making saving to external storage instant.
- **TUI Download History Recording**: All successful single and playlist downloads performed in the TUI playground are automatically recorded to the local history store.
